recent.title: Lint Prioritisation — Not Every Warning Needs a Fix
recent.summary: James directed that lint findings be prioritised by business impact, not fixed blindly. Four-question test: customers? memory/reasoning? execution? trust? Engineering work never takes priority over customer outcomes unless materially improving reliability.
